neighbr
  api (backend, hono)
    horses: Horse
      GET /horses
      GET /horses/[id]
      POST /horses
      PATCH /horses/[id]
      DELETE /horses/[id]
      GET /horses/[id]/swipes
      GET /horses/[id]/swiped_by
      GET /horses/[id]/first_matches
      GET /horses/[id]/second_matches
    swipes: Swipe
      GET /swipes
      POST /swipes
    matches: Match
      GET /matches
      GET /matches/[id]
    swipe (endpoint)
      POST /swipe
      steps: record_swipe, match_if_mutual
  web (frontend, nextjs) uses api
  data (3 entities)
    Horse
    Swipe
    Match
